hooks.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/scripts/agent_guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; py=$(command -v python || command -v python3) || exit 0; "$py" "$f"
hooks.commandWindows: python -c "import runpy, subprocess; root = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], text=True).strip(); runpy.run_path(root + '/scripts/agent_guard.py', run_name='__main__')"; exit $LASTEXITCODE
